stories.title: Fake news on Armenian NPP aimed at undermining ties with Russia — diplomat
stories.summary: MOSCOW, August 22. Moscow views fake news about an alleged safety threat posed by the Metsamor Nuclear Power Plant in Armenia as an attempt to disrupt energy ties between he two countries, the Russian Foreign Ministry’s official spokeswoman, Maria Zakharova, said. Earlier, foreign media started to publish rumors about an alleged safety threat posed by the NPP, claiming that the it puts for the entire region in danger and should be put out of operation.
